# Seaside Wellness of Palm Beach

> Seaside Wellness is a luxury addiction treatment and mental health facility in West Palm Beach, Florida, offering evidence-based medical detox, residential inpatient, and dual diagnosis care.

Address: 106 Blossom Ln, West Palm Beach, FL 33404. Admissions (24/7): (855) 416-5648 · info@seasidewellnesspb.com. Canonical site: https://www.seasidewellnesspb.com/

## Treatment Programs

- [Addiction & Mental Health Treatment Programs](https://www.seasidewellnesspb.com/treatment/): Medical detox, residential inpatient, dual diagnosis, aftercare, and individual, group and family therapy — all in West Palm Beach, Florida.
- [Aftercare & Alumni Support](https://www.seasidewellnesspb.com/treatment/aftercare/): Sustain your recovery with Seaside Wellness of Palm Beach. Our comprehensive aftercare & alumni programs provide the support needed for lifelong sobriety.
- [Medical Drug & Alcohol Detox](https://www.seasidewellnesspb.com/treatment/detox/): Start recovery with safe alcohol and drug detox at Seaside Wellness. Our West Palm Beach center offers 24/7 care and medical supervision.
- [Dual Diagnosis Treatment](https://www.seasidewellnesspb.com/treatment/dual-diagnosis/): Heal mind and body at Seaside Wellness — expert dual diagnosis and detox care at our private Palm Beach center. Start your recovery today.
- [Family Therapy in Addiction Recovery](https://www.seasidewellnesspb.com/treatment/family-therapy/): Seaside Wellness offers family therapy in West Palm Beach to rebuild trust, improve communication, and strengthen support during recovery.
- [Group Therapy in Addiction Treatment](https://www.seasidewellnesspb.com/treatment/group-therapy/): Join supportive group therapy sessions at Seaside Wellness in West Palm Beach. Build connection and confidence for lasting recovery.
- [Individual Therapy in Addiction Treatment](https://www.seasidewellnesspb.com/treatment/individual-therapy/): Discover personalized individual therapy at Seaside Wellness in West Palm Beach. Heal and build lasting recovery with one-on-one support.
- [Residential Mental Health Treatment](https://www.seasidewellnesspb.com/treatment/mental-health-residential/): Find healing at Seaside Wellness. Our residential mental health treatment in West Palm Beach offers comfort, structure, and compassionate care.
- [Residential Addiction Rehab](https://www.seasidewellnesspb.com/treatment/substance-abuse-residential/): Heal in a private, tropical sanctuary. Seaside Wellness offers physician-led residential treatment for dual diagnosis & addiction in Palm Beach.
